name: Blekingetrafiken
coverage_note: Zone-based. Pågatåg Nordost into Blekinge is Skånetrafiken agency and is INTENTIONALLY excluded (adding Skånetrafiken would zero all of Skåne) — those legs stay paid (conservative under-coverage). Öresundståg/Krösatåg gated to Blekinge stops.

name: Dalatrafik
coverage_note: Since 2024-06-01 the blue county period ticket is valid on Tåg i Bergslagen to the nearest kommun-centrum across the border (dalatrafik.se tib-lansgrans, verified 2026-07: 'kan du åka med Tåg i Bergslagen till närmaste kommuncentrum över länsgränsen'). Seeded those named stations that are NOT already in Dalarna: Fagersta Norra, Hofors, Karbenning, Kopparberg, Sala, Sandviken, Storvik, Ställdalen, Torsåker. Fagersta C is already in-region. 'SJ' would be intra-Dalarna only and is NOT honored here (over-coverage risk on the SJ agency).

name: Din Tur
coverage_note: Norrtåg only within Västernorrland (Sundsvall–Härnösand–Örnsköldsvik, Stöde–Sundsvall). Cross-county Norrtåg needs Norrlandsresan. denied_stops (web-verified 2026-07, dintur.se: länskort 'inom Västernorrlands län'): Hoting (Strömsunds kommun, Jämtland) — Din Tur's own line 39 reaches it but the county card does not.

name: Jönköpings Länstrafik (JLT)
coverage_note: Zone-based within county. Cross-county Sydtaxan tickets extend SJ kust-kust to Kalmar/Kronoberg (so SJ is not strictly county-internal). HARD LIMIT: never valid on SJ Regional or Västtåg into Västra Götaland (Göteborg/Borås). 'Västtrafik' and 'SJ' need strict region-stops gating; SJ high-speed over-coverage risk. denied_stops (web-verified 2026-07, jlt.se periodbiljett + resor-over-lansgrans: areas are 1 zon/2 zoner/Hela länet, cross-county = separate Sydtaxan product): Halmstad C, Sannarp, Oskarström, Torup, Kinnared, Landeryd, Hyltebruk (Halland, HNJ-line); Växjö (Kronoberg); Hultsfred (Kalmar).

name: Kalmar Länstrafik (KLT)
coverage_note: Zone-based; 5+ zones = full county länsgiltighet. KLT's own Krösatåg lines cross three borders, putting out-of-county stations in the agency stop set where the länskort is NOT valid (web-verified 2026-07: ÖT-side pricing applies inom Östergötland per ostgotatrafiken.se biljettsamarbeten/krosatagen; KLT sells a SEPARATE 30-dagars 'för resor utanför Kalmar län – exempelvis till Karlskrona' per kalmarlanstrafik.se). denied_stops: Linköping C, Tannefors, Åtvidaberg, Rimforsa, Falerum, Basthagen, Kisa (Östergötland); Karlskrona C, Bergåsa (Blekinge); Nässjö C (Jönköping). Sydtaxan relation-priced cross-county period tickets exist as separate products, matching the plain-card model.

name: SL (Storstockholms Lokaltrafik)
coverage_note: Flat, zone-free; validity polygon = Stockholms län + Bålsta + Gnesta, all under 'SL' agency. Waxholmsbolaget is CONDITIONAL: whole network free low season 14 Sep–29 Apr, 44 central piers year-round, 30-day+ period ticket only. EXCLUSIONS: Arlanda C gate (separate Arlandapassage ~130 kr, not free); Arlanda Express (never free); Mälartåg/SJ through the county (need Movingo). denied_stops: pendeltåg 40 runs to Knivsta (740000559) and Uppsala C (740000005) which are in Uppsala län and need a UL fare - an operator-only card would otherwise wrongly free them.

name: Skånetrafiken
coverage_note: Zone-based. Skånetrafiken-agency legs (incl. Pågatåg) are operator-only-safe within Skåne; Öresundståg/Krösatåg free ONLY within Skåne stops, never onward to Göteborg/Västtrafik or Copenhagen. Safe only for the full-region (stor zon / hela Skåne) card variant. denied_stops: Skånetrafiken's OWN trains cross the county line (Pågatåg Nordost + västkusten), putting out-of-county stations in the agency's stop set where the Skåne card is NOT valid - Älmhult (740000045) + Markaryd (740000258) in Kronoberg; Karlshamn (740000073), Sölvesborg (740000079), Mörrum (740000366), Olofström (740000441 + bussterminal 740011176) in Blekinge; Halmstad C (740000080) + Laholm (740000058) in Halland. Residual: out-of-county village BUS stops served by Skånetrafiken buses are not individually denied; express-bus legs ending at one could still be freed wrongly (known, low exposure).

name: UL (Region Uppsala)
coverage_note: County-wide (zones abolished). A UL ticket is valid on Mälartåg to the first station across each border - Gävle C (740000210), Märsta (740000027), Arlanda C (740000556) - but NOT onward into the SL/X-trafik network (that needs a UL+SL combination ticket). Verified at ul.se/travel-across-county-borders (2026-07): 'For journeys with line 501, 510 and Mälartåg to/from Gävleborg county, all UL tickets are valid'. Sala is omitted here because UL's own agency already serves it (in-region, covered without a border stop). Arlanda C: the ride is covered but the station passage fee is added on top (see surcharges.py).

name: Värmlandstrafik (incl. Karlstadsbuss)
coverage_note: Original research claim REFUTED and corrected: lines 70/73 are the Oslo–Karlstad–Stockholm corridor (NOT Göteborg); Västtrafik was wrongly omitted (lines 71/72); the card DOES extend beyond zones (Årskort Län Oslo–Karlstad–Degerfors, Pendlar Plus to Örebro, delbetalning Oslo–Stockholm). 2nd class only, activation receipt required. Cross-border product exceptions break a pure region-stops gate — needs a per-product allow-list.

name: Västtrafik
coverage_note: Zone A/B/C; ABC = whole VG + Kungsbacka. Öresundståg capped at Åsa (Varberg is out-of-area). SJ = Regional only on 3 named lines, 2nd class — but GTFS agency 'SJ' also carries high-speed X2000/SJ3000 which is NOT free (over-coverage risk). 'Vy Norge' is an INFERRED, unverified GTFS string for the Göteborg–Halden Vy Tåg line. denied_stops (web-verified 2026-07: base Zon ABC = 'Västtrafiks område (VGR och Kungsbacka kommun)'; the very existence of the purchasable 'Extra Örebro V' / 'Extra Län Jönköping' / 'Extra Värmland S' period supplements proves the base card stops at the border): Örebro C, Örebro Södra, Kumla, Hallsberg, Laxå (Örebro län, Kinnekulletåget/Västtågen); Nässjö C (Jönköping, Västtågen); Årjäng (Värmland, buss 755). Line-specific exception: VT tickets valid to Säffle on SJ Göteborg–Åmål–Säffle — not generalizable, not modeled.

name: X-trafik
coverage_note: Zone-based. Mälartåg only the Gävle–Furuvik stub. SJ only to/from Sundsvall with county/Sundsvall validity; other SJ needs a paid supplement (over-coverage risk on the 'SJ' agency). Region-stops set spans Gävleborg + the Sundsvall X-tåget corridor endpoint. border_stops: the county-validity 30-day/annual ticket gives free Tåg i Bergslagen travel across the Dalarna border to Fors (740000704), Horndals Bruk (740000630) and Avesta Krylbo (740000111), verified 2026-07 at xtrafik.se/tag-i-bergslagen. Re-verified 2026-07 in the geography audit: Sundsvall C/Västra + Njurundabommen are genuinely covered (xtrafik.se/sj + /stadsbussarna-i-sundsvall: länsbiljett carries Sundsvall rights incl. city buses), and Falun C is covered via the SAME TiB agreement ('obegränsat resande med TiB till/från Falun, Horndalsbruk, Fors och Avesta/Krylbo') — it sits in the agency stop set so it needs no border_stops entry, but the mechanism is the agreement, not X-tåget reach.

name: Östgötatrafiken
coverage_note: Zone-based (Liten/Mellan/Stor/Län). Krösatåg free only within Östergötland — never onward to Kalmar/Nässjö/Hultsfred. Region-stops set must include Tranås (Jönköping county) since Östgötapendeln terminates there and is covered. denied_stops (web-verified 2026-07): Eksjö (Jönköping) — ÖT's own bus 631 reaches it but the län-biljett zone is 'Hela Östergötland' only.

name: Hallandstrafiken
coverage_note: Zone-based, own bus absent from feed. 'Västtrafik' here means Västtågen WITHIN Halland only — including VG's home agency is safe ONLY under strict region-stops gating on Halland-internal stops (needs station-level fencing). Pågatåg into Halland is Skånetrafiken agency, not honored. extra_region_stops: Halmstad C (740000080) — the county's main station, inside Halland and covered by the card, but absent from the agency-derived region because every train there runs under a train operator's agency while Hallandstrafiken's own feed vehicles are buses that never call at the rail parent.

name: Länstrafiken Kronoberg
coverage_note: Zone-based. Own bus network is NOT an agency in the intercity feed. SJ Regional valid within their area only (over-coverage risk: 'SJ' agency also = high-speed). Gate all to Kronoberg stops. denied_stops (web-verified 2026-07): Halmstad C Resecentrum + Veinge (Halland) — reachable by the agency's buses but outside the county card; note Markarydsbanan Halmstad–Markaryd has NO passenger service until ~2028 (Trafikverket), planned operator is Pågatåg, not Krösatåg — revisit at opening.

name: Länstrafiken Norrbotten
coverage_note: Norrtåg within Norrbotten (Älvsbyn–Luleå, Luleå–Boden–Haparanda, Boden–Gällivare–Kiruna). Cross-county via Norrlandsresan.

name: Länstrafiken Västerbotten
coverage_note: Norrtåg within Västerbotten (Umeå–Vännäs, Umeå–Örnsköldsvik stretch, Umeå–Lycksele/Hällnäs). Cross-county needs Norrlandsresan (tabussen.nu lansbiljett + resor-over-lansgranser, verified 2026-07: länsbiljett 'gäller på samtliga busslinjer i Västerbottens län samt på Norrtåg'). denied_stops: the agency's long inter-county bus lines (45, 100/20 Norrlandskusten) put out-of-county stops in the region set — Östersund C + busstation (Jämtland), Hammerdal (Jämtland), Gällivare, Jokkmokk, Haparanda x4 (Norrbotten) — none covered by the länsbiljett.

name: Länstrafiken i Jämtlands län
coverage_note: Own bus absent from feed — only Norrtåg maps. Norrtåg Storlien–Åre–Östersund–Bräcke within Jämtland. Cross-county needs Norrlandsresan (ltr.se resor-over-lansgrans, verified 2026-07: länskort is county-only). denied_stops: the agency's own buses cross the border, putting out-of-county stops in the region set — Mora + Orsa (Dalarna), Ljusdal + Färila (Gävleborg), Sollefteå + Örnsköldsvik C (Västernorrland), Dorotea (Västerbotten). Hoting (Strömsunds kommun) is IN-county and stays covered.

name: Länstrafiken Örebro
coverage_note: Own bus absent from feed; TiB/Mälartåg within Örebro län. Since 2023-12-11 the whole-county period ticket is automatically valid on Tåg i Bergslagen across the border to Ludvika (Dalarna, 740000291) and Skinnskatteberg (Västmanland, 740000186) - Länstrafiken Örebro press release: 'behöver inte göra någonting ... Den nya giltigheten läggs till automatiskt'. Travel BEYOND those two stations is paid, so only they are seeded. Cross-county rail further out needs Movingo.

name: Movingo (Mälardalstrafik)
coverage_note: SPECIAL — really a relation/route product, not a region polygon. VARIANT-GATED: most Movingo tickets are sold per sträcka (relation), so auto-freeing the 6-county union would over-cover a per-relation holder; it is registered as hint-only (never auto-freed) until per-relation modeling captures the chosen sträcka. Sold per sträcka OR 'Alla sträckor'. SJ = Regional on Movingo-flagged departures only (never X2000/other fast/night). Bundles local traffic (SL/UL/VL/Sörmland/Örebro/Östgöta) along the relation. Uppsala–Knivsta–Arlanda/Märsta carries UL validity only, not SL. 5/30 flex excludes SJ. region-stops over the 6-county union over-approximates the all-routes variant; per-relation cards need route modeling (capture chosen sträcka).

name: Norrlandsresan (shared northern card)
coverage_note: Shared 30-day card, not tied to one PTA. VARIANT-GATED: only 'en del av' ticket types are accepted and the accepted subset is unverified, so it is registered as hint-only (never auto-freed) rather than risk over-covering a 4-county union. Frees Norrtåg anywhere across Norrbotten/Västerbotten/Västernorrland/Jämtland + the listed PTA buses (also Skellefteå Buss / Luleå Lokaltrafik / Länstrafiken Jämtland buses, absent from feed). Model as a 4-county region-stops union. Only 'en del av' ticket types accepted — verify accepted subset.

name: Sörmlandstrafiken (Region Sörmland)
coverage_note: Own bus absent from feed. Mälartåg between stations within Södermanland only; cross-county needs Movingo.

name: VL (Region Västmanland)
coverage_note: Own bus absent from feed. The VL länsbiljett is valid on Tåg i Bergslagen to the nearest kommun-centrum in an adjacent county (vl.se tågbiljetter, verified 2026-07: 'kan du dessutom resa till närmsta kommun-centrum i angränsande län. Som till exempel på sträckorna Fagersta – Örebro eller Sala – Avesta'). Seeded Örebro C (740000133); Avesta Krylbo is already in-region. Avesta centrum (a separate halt) is NOT seeded - unverified for the base ticket. SJ validity is intra-Västmanland only and not honored here.
